name: 93619 · Clovis, CA
findings: ZIP 93619 (Clovis) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 29 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93619 (Clovis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93619 (Clovis) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
